findings.current: In the chaos of enemies who’d already died returning as their comrades, they’d seen through his weakness.
findings.defect: The draft turns dead enemies into comrades; the source says enemies and comrades alike are rising again.
findings.rationale: 적들이, 동료들이 names both groups as subjects of 되살아나는.
findings.replacement: Amid the chaos of fallen enemies and comrades alike rising again, they’d seen through his weakness.
findings.source: 이미 한 번 죽은 적들이, 동료들이 되살아나는 이 혼란스러운 상황 속에서 약점을 간파해 냈다.

findings.current: More than ten streams of blood burst through flesh and bone like flashes of light.
findings.defect: Blood streams replace the greatsword fragments that lodge in Golden Ox Palace’s body.
findings.rationale: The preceding sentence sends the shattered blade’s fragments toward him; 틀어박힌 says they lodge in his flesh.
findings.replacement: More than ten blood-streaked shards shot into him like flashes of light, shattering flesh and bone as they lodged inside.
findings.source: 마치 섬광처럼 살과 뼈를 부수며 틀어박힌 십여 개의 핏줄기.

findings.current: And to fulfill his master’s order—to use himself as a shield to bring that giant down.
findings.defect: The draft makes Golden Ox Palace choose to use himself as a shield. His master intends to use him as one.
findings.rationale: 방패막이로 삼아 그 거인을 쓰러트리려 하는 modifies 주인, identifying the master as the one using him.
findings.replacement: And to carry out the order of his master, who meant to use him as a shield to bring that giant down.
findings.source: 그리고 자신을 방패막이로 삼아 그 거인을 쓰러트리려 하는 주인의 명령을 완수하기 위해.

findings.defect: “Famous” loses the contrast between fierce battlefield fighters and exceptional commanders.
findings.rationale: 명장 contrasts a commander distinguished by ability with the 맹장 mentioned immediately before, not merely someone widely known.
findings.replacement: But truly great commanders were rare.

summary: The draft has three substantive action and subject errors, plus a loss of meaning in the contrast between kinds of generals.
